title: Tech Fest
description:
TechFest Sri Lanka 2025 was a national-level technology event organized under the IEEE Sri Lanka Section Student Activities Committee (SLSAC) as the flagship event of the TechVerse project. The event brought together university students, industry professionals, and technology enthusiasts to explore the latest trends in software engineering, Artificial Intelligence, cloud computing, cybersecurity, and emerging technologies.

The event featured keynote speeches, technical sessions, and panel discussions conducted by leading professionals from the Sri Lankan tech industry. TechFest provided participants with valuable insights into current industry practices, career opportunities, and technological innovations while creating a platform for networking and knowledge sharing between students and industry experts.
agenda: 9:00 AM – 9:15 AM	Welcome Address & Opening Ceremony
9:15 AM – 10:00 AM	Keynote Session 1 – The Future of AI & Emerging Technologies
11:00 AM – 11:45 AM	Technical Session – Software Engineering & Cloud Technologies
11:45 AM – 12:30 PM	Panel Discussion with Industry Experts
3:15 PM – 4:00 PM	Q&A Session and Audience Interaction
4:00 PM – 4:30 PM	Vote of Thanks & Certificate Distribution

title: PyCon US 2026

title: React Conf
